title: (HAVANA) Set áo kiểu nữ DONNA hai dây voan tơ kèm cardigan

clips.goal: Giữ chân người xem: đứng yên nhìn thẳng ống kính 2 giây đầu để người lướt dừng lại đọc hook, rồi mới khoe lưng trần bằng một vòng xoay trọn.

beats.action: Stands square to the lens with feet planted, holds steady eye contact, one hand resting on the strap, quiet breathing.
Turns a full 360 degrees in place at an even pace, hem lifting with the turn and hair settling as the back comes into view.
Completes the turn and settles back into the opening stance, returning to the lens so the clip loops.
must_not: end with the back to the lens

negative: One continuous shot, staying inside the frame, with no cut
no added lettering or printed graphics
clips.motion_prompt: Camera pushes in slowly at natural real-time speed. For the first two seconds the model stands square to the lens with feet planted, holds steady eye contact, one hand resting on the strap, natural blinks and quiet breathing. From the second to the fifth second the model turns a full 360 degrees in place at an even pace, hem lifting with the turn and hair settling as the back comes into view. In the final three seconds the model, holding steady eye contact with the lens, completes the turn and settles back into the opening stance, returning to the lens so the clip loops. One continuous shot, staying inside the frame, with no cut. No added lettering or printed graphics.

clips.goal: Khoe phom set đồ ở góc nghiêng: cho cardigan rơi mở ra để lộ lớp voan của áo hai dây, rồi kết đúng tư thế mở đầu để 16 giây phát lặp không giật.

beats.action: Angles forty-five degrees to one side and lifts the sheer cardigan higher on the shoulder, eyes settling downward once toward the sleeve.
Rolls the shoulders softly and shifts weight between the feet, letting the cardigan fall open over the camisole.
Returns to the lens and settles into the opening stance of the previous clip so the sequence loops.
must_not: end on a different stance than clip1 frame one

negative: One continuous shot, staying inside the frame
clips.motion_prompt: Continuing from that pose, camera drifts closer on the same axis. For the first three seconds the model angles forty-five degrees to one side and lifts the sheer cardigan higher on the shoulder, eyes settling downward once toward the sleeve. From the third to the sixth second the model rolls the shoulders softly and shifts weight between the feet, letting the cardigan fall open over the camisole. In the last two seconds the model returns to the lens and settles into the opening stance of the previous clip so the sequence loops. One continuous shot, staying inside the frame.
